offence: Breach of Article 48.1 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and determined that part of the contact patch of Car 81's front tyres were outside the lines of the grid box at the time of the Start Signal. This is a breach of Art 48.1.c of the FIA Formula Sporting Regulations. This attracts a mandatory time penalty under Art 54.3 of the Sporting Regulations. Given the limited extent of the breach, we determined that a 5-second time penalty was appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 81 Incorrect Starting Position
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
